sources.title: Amazon Associates Program Operating Agreement
sources.supports: Section 5 'Identifying Yourself as an Associate' (required disclosure wording). Section 6 (violation of Section 5 is a material breach). Section 12 incorporates the Program Policies (see S8).

sources.title: Amazon Associates Program Policies (Participation Requirements, Commission Income Statement)
sources.supports: Participation Requirements s.1 (Unsuitable Sites incl. Amazon trademarks in domain name or tag; non-US person clause). s.2(a)-(b) (Special Links must include the Associates ID/tag; prices and availability may be shown only via an Amazon-served link or PA-API/Creators API; product lists need original content). Commission Income Statement s.1 (Qualifying Purchases; Qualifying Revenue excludes shipping, taxes, gift wrap, fees, credits). s.2(e) (Redirecting Link purchases are disqualified). s.3 (Standard Commission Income is a % of Qualifying Revenue).
sources.review_note: Page header states 'Updated: April 14, 2026'. The Appendix rates link goes to S9, which was not reachable.

sources.supports: Nothing. Both the URL and its trailing-slash variant redirected to the Amazon sign-in page. Third-party rate tables disagree with each other (for example, Home & Kitchen shown as 3%, 4%, 6% and 8%), so none were used.
sources.review_note: Commission rates are left blank and flagged as unverified.

sources.title: FTC: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
sources.supports: Disclose any financial relationship (a material connection) with a brand. Place the disclosure where it is hard to miss, with the endorsement itself. Do not rely on an About page or a link to read more. Do not claim experience with a product you have not tried.

sources.supports: A branch can publish a /docs folder. Settings > Pages > Build and deployment selects the branch and folder. GitHub Actions can also be used.

sources.title: Creators API documentation: prerequisites (Welcome page)
sources.supports: Prerequisites: enrolled in Associates for the target marketplace; at least 10 qualifying sales within the past 30 days to access the PA API through the Creators API; register for API access; generate credentials.
sources.review_note: Read by arena-4ba9e055 in an independent cross-check. Quote: 'Have at least 10 qualifying sales within the past 30 days to access the PA API through the Creators API'.

sources.title: PA-API 5 deprecation notice (Creators API docs)
sources.supports: PA-API 5 is deprecated and replaced by the Creators API. Applications that still call PA-API 5 receive HTTP 403 with AccessDeniedException.
